proposals_detail.text: I understand you need a reliable RAG support assistant to handle tier‑1 tickets within a two‑week timeline. In 2025 I delivered a RAG support assistant for a SaaS company that resolved 62 % of tier‑1 support tickets without escalation, using LangChain, FastAPI and pgvector. [cs-ai_ml-rag_support] The core module I built leveraged the PGVector integration shown in the repository, enabling efficient similarity search over 3,000 help‑centre articles. [rd-ai_ml-rag_support] My background in FastAPI, RAG is reflected in my CV, confirming the required expertise. Throughout the project I will provide daily updates and a final handover call to ensure your team can operate the assistant independently.

I understand you need a reliable Expo‑based fitness tracking mobile app that syncs data in real time for your users. I recently delivered a full‑stack fitness tracking app for a fitness company using React Native, Expo, and Firebase, achieving a 4.7 rating on both iOS and Android stores [cs-fullstack-mobile]. The solution incorporated live activity streams via WebSockets, ensuring instant updates across devices [cs-fullstack-chat]. I will structure the project in six two‑week sprints, providing a working solution, comprehensive documentation, and a handover call within the six‑week timeline. Documentation will cover architecture, Firebase rules, Expo configuration, and WebSocket integration, enabling your team to maintain and extend the app confidently. I will implement automated unit and integration tests to ensure stability across iOS and Android platforms. My rate of $40/h aligns with the proposed budget of $2,288, and I am ready to start immediately. ZEBRA309

I understand you need a reliable shipment ETL pipeline that integrates Airflow, PostgreSQL, and visual reporting in Looker Studio. In a recent project for a logistics company, I designed and built a full‑stack shipment ETL pipeline using Airflow, Python, and PostgreSQL, automating 14 daily data feeds with 99.7% on‑time performance [cs-data_analyst-etl]. I also delivered Looker Studio dashboards that turned the processed data into actionable visualizations, as demonstrated in a GA4 analytics implementation [rv-data_analyst-ga4] and a KPI reporting framework [rd-data_analyst-kpi]. The four‑week timeline fits the scope, and I propose a fixed price of $2,002, aligning with your budget.
